headline: Leite has big baskets in overtime as the Fire end the season with a 90-82 win over the Valkyries
description: — Carla Leite made the tiebreaking basket with 1:57 left in overtime and then converted a three-point play with 26.5 seconds to play as the Portland Fire ended the season with a 90-82 victory over the Golden State Valkyries on Tuesday night.

headline: A'ja Wilson powers the Aces past the Sparks, clinching at least a No. 3 seed
description: — Four-time MVP A'ja Wilson scored 18 points and grabbed 10 rebounds to lead the Aces to an 89-79 victory over the Los Angeles Sparks on Tuesday night and clinch at least a No. 3 playoff seed for Las Vegas.

headline: Lynx pull starters vs. Fever but clinch 1-seed with Valkyries' loss
description: The Lynx went into the second-to-last game of the season against the Fever with a chance to wrap up the No. 1 seed -- which they eventually did thanks to a Valkyries loss -- but coach Cheryl Reeve didn't play her normal starters in the second half.

headline: Jaquez, Taylor help Sky beat Tempo 97-85, snap 5-game losing streak
description: — Gabriela Jaquez and Sydney Taylor scored 18 points apiece, Kamilla Cardoso added 17, and the Chicago Sky beat the Toronto Tempo 97-85 on Tuesday night to snap a five-game losing streak.

headline: Austin has 25 points and 13 rebounds as the Mystics beat the Sun 79-69 for franchise-record 27th win

headline: Stewart's 9-year no-tech streak snapped in Liberty's loss
description: Breanna Stewart's nine-year run of not getting a technical foul has come to an end after she picked one up in New York's 95-84 loss to Atlanta
